tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: One important part of traveling is deciding to go alone or with a group. Thinking about a place you would like to visit, would you prefer to go there alone or with a group? Why?

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Finally, one major issue with travel today is overcrowding. Popular places have so many tourists visiting at one time that the sights are unable to allow all the people to visit who want to. As a result, virtual travel experiences are becoming more common compared to real life travel. Do you think a virtual travel experience is worthwhile? Why are why not?
